dedupe_keys.name: kartverket havnedata detailed geographic data on norwegian ports quays cranes shore power and mooring

description: A national standard and dataset for detailed geographic information about ports, quays and the objects that belong to a quay or harbour. Contents: the catalogue entry lists port facilities, quay fronts, water outlets, shore power connection points, emergency equipment, sensors, waste points, cranes, slipways, fenders, mooring devices, emptying stations and fences, plus mappable regulations that relate to ports. The specification is built for management in a central database on the NGIS platform, the same concept as the national base map database. Producer: Kartverket. Coverage: Norway. Format and access: FGDB, GML, PostGIS and SOSI through Geonorge, and a WMS; the catalogue updated it on 16 September 2026. Licence: the Norge digitalt licence with limited access (Norge digitalt begrenset), so it is not open data and access goes through Norge digitalt parties or Kartverket. Caveats: coverage per port depends on what municipalities and port operators have registered, which the entry does not state. Simulation uses: port asset inventories for maritime logistics, shore power demand and port resilience models. Related records: the Kystverket fairway and navigation aid records cover the sea side.
